game.name: Tiger Woods Pga Tour 09 (World)
game.desc: The most famous golfer of them all comes to life in Tiger Woods PGA Tour 09 on PS3. Tiger Woods' personal coach (Hank Hankey) will give you valuable advice throughout the game. This opus has focused on the player's progression with a system that adapts to all levels. It is also possible to play the fairway with 4 players via an online mode.
